name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (battle/spell). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own address 0x212B9 or any data address). The '_variant_b' suffix is the established convention in this file for a byte-identical second physical placement (dead clone) of fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227, distinct from the true semantic sibling fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell. Name correctly mirrors the live worker. Keep.
purpose: Dead-code/orphan clone of the blink-overlay offensive targeted-spell worker fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227; byte-identical body, no callers, not in the spell dispatch table.
logic_summary: Resets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx to 0, plays the per-target impact animation then the overlay-blink animation, deducts the caster's MP for spell_id, then loops over the target-id byte array applying fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id, spell_id): damage 0 draws the miss indicator, otherwise the damage number with glyph 0x5E ('^'). Closes via the Pattern-A shared epilogue @ 0x21190 (fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths()); no explicit RET (JGE-tail-jump). Body is byte-identical to 0x21227 (all 6 basic-block hashes match) and is never invoked (0 callers, 0 xrefs, absent from the 24-entry dispatch table @ 0x51D01).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell_variant_b(int caster, int spell_id, int n_targets, int p_targets)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Casting unit id; forwarded to the impact/blink animations and fd2_deduct_caster_mp.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the live worker's emitted param name; no address residue.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell id; keys the impact + overlay-blink animations, the MP deduction, and the per-target magic damage calc.
params.reason: Accurate name for the spell id operand; no address residue.

params.name: n_targets
params.semantics: Number of targets; loop bound over the target-id byte array, also passed as the 3rd arg to the two animation calls.
params.reason: Descriptive count name; no address residue.

params.name: p_targets
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id byte array (each entry a unit id); read as ((uint8 *)p_targets)[iter] inside the loop and forwarded to the animation calls.
params.reason: Descriptive pointer name (p_ prefix); matches the live worker; no address residue. Type kept as int per emitted source (address contract); type changes are out of scope.

returns.semantics: No return value. Function has no explicit RET; control exits via JGE-tail-jump into the shared epilogue @ 0x21190 which RETs.
